description: Group portrait of O'Keeffe holding a Siamese cat standing next to two young adult  women and a baby; the women are identified as Maria and Bernie, and the baby as Little Max; O'Keeffe is wearing a collared long sleeve shirt with her sleeves rolled up and  jeans; she has a large bandage wrapped around the wrist of her left hand which she uses to hold and cradle the neck of the cat; she looks at the camera with a big grin, her long hair falls on her shoulder and is combed away from her face; Bernie holds baby Max who is dressed in white and wrapped in a white blanket; a stuffed black bird with extended wings is mounted on the adobe wall or the portal, three vigas can be seen at the top of the photograph.
title: Maria, Bernie, Little Max, The Gato, and Georgia O'Keeffe
